customer_message.subject: Rent increase notice for Gartenweg 54 - need help contesting
customer_message.body: Hi, my name is Taylor Brooks and I rent the 3.5-room flat at Gartenweg 54 in Frauenfeld from Wohnbau Limmat GmbH. Thanks for picking this up, I really need some help. Last week I got a written notification from the landlord that my rent will go up. I have the letter and I scanned the tenancy agreement too. Right now I pay CHF 1760 net per month, the lease started on 1 April 2014. The landlord says the increase is because of renovation and value-enhancing investment work on the building. I have not seen any invoices or details of what was actually done, and I do not know if the work really increases the value of my flat. The letter also mentions a rise in the mortgage reference interest rate, but I am not sure whether the increase is based on the mortgage reference interest rate, on the renovation, or on both. I have not yet checked the calculation because I do not understand the form they sent. Could you tell me if I can contest this and what the deadline is? I do not want to miss the window to object. Also, should I pay the new rent until this is sorted out or wait? Thanks, Taylor
